title: A unit-scale blow-up η_{−v,1#} is the translation by v
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), v ∈ ℝ^P and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n). Then there is a test form ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(v + y) for every y ∈ ℝ^P such that currentEval(blowUp S (−v) 1, ω) = S(ω'). Here blowUp S (−v) 1 = η_{−v,1#}S ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{−v,1}(ℝ^P)) is the push-forward of S by the dilation η_{−v,1}(y) = −(1⁻¹·(−v)) + 1⁻¹·y = v + y (contract blowUp: restrictDomain followed by affinePushforward with linear part dilationCLM P 1 and translation −(1⁻¹•(−v))), and currentEval T φ is T(φ) when φ is a test form with tsupport φ inside the domain of T, and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), ∃ ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (v + y)) ∧ currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω'
